criteria.requirement: Repair Text integer indexing: normalize a negative offset exactly once against codepoint length, enforce normal IndexError at both bounds and transfer base style plus every overlapping span to the one-character result. Positive and corresponding negative indexes are semantically identical; preserve source Text untouched, Unicode codepoint indexing, empty behavior, end="" on the selected character and existing slice rules. Do not clamp too-negative indexes to zero or turn indexing into grapheme segmentation. This is a complete styled-selection repair with real overlapping style checks.
